children: HURCO COMPANIES INC reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $47.29M and diluted EPS of $0.35, driven by higher shipment volumes and improved margins; the company swung to net income of $2.31M from a loss a year earlier. — 10-Q Summary
¹ Reported as “Sales and service fees”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Income (loss) per common share”.
Revenue growth was driven by higher-volume shipments and price increases, which boosted gross margins.
Regional performance shifted: Americas and Asia Pacific strengthened (Americas +12% YTD; APAC +30% YTD) while Europe declined about 8% YTD.
Product demand was led by Hurco 5-axis and higher-performance mills, Takumi machines, and Milltronics lathes.
Order intake and backlog improved, with orders up roughly 24% year-to-date (Q3 orders +25%), led by the Americas and APAC, indicating stronger future shipments.
Operational actions included cost reductions, inventory management, tariff refund recoveries, and continued investment in R&D and automation.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
